content:
**Welded** is an Armor Mod in *Fallout 76*.

When applied to an armor arm, leg or chest piece, it improves Damage and Energy Resistance.

Armor modifications will modify an existing armor, and any modifications previously equipped on the armor will be destroyed, not unequipped. Loose mods cannot be crafted. For modifications unlocked through scrapping, the corresponding armor must be scrapped in order to learn how to craft it. The mods for marine, raider and trapper armors are considered first-tier material and as such are known by default. The mods for the Brotherhood and Secret Service armor parts require their respective plans to be crafted.
